A set of four, made for a housewarming, is a gift that does a job from the first morning. cases.text: With its modern take on traditional brass, the Madhu Ghee Pot With Ladle is a very festive piece, and one of our new favourites. For Diwali gifts, it travels well: wrapped in tissue, carried in one hand to a relative's house, and set down on a table among the sweets. The ladle fits inside the pot so the two never separate. The brass is handcrafted and takes on a soft glow the more it is used, and it asks only a wipe after each pour. Give it to someone who cooks on the day and also on the days after, because ghee for a dal on an ordinary Tuesday is exactly what it was shaped to hold. It belongs on the kitchen counter in plain view, not in a cupboard, and over time it becomes the thing a house is known for, and remembered by.

cases.text: A pure silk scarf named for the guldasta, or bouquet, printed all over in garden florals. For your mother's birthday, it is the kind of gift that she will not need to be told how to wear. Finished with a baby roll hemline and tassels at opposite corners, it falls well over a shoulder or knots loosely at the neck. Pair it with a cotton sari for lunch, or a plain kurta for the evening, and it will lift both without taking over either. Silk like this softens as it is worn, so the more she uses it, the better it hangs. Wrap it in the box it comes in, and add a line in your own hand.
